Cluster colonies into groups

bdy_clustering.Rd

Clustering colonies into group using Mean Shift Algorithm. Used by bdy_process_count_data

Usage

bdy_clustering(coord, h_km = 5, dist_regr_isol = 4 * h_km, regroupIsolates = T)

Arguments

coord

data frame where each line is a colony, with columns 'lat' for latitude and 'lon' for longitudce

h_km

bandwidth (in km) used by the Clustering Algorithm (colonies within that distance of another will be regrouped)

dist_regr_isol

maximum distance to regroup an isolated colony to closest cluster

regroupIsolates

logical; whether isolated colonies should be grouped with closest cluster (based on dist_regr_isol)

Value

Vector of length nrow(coord) giving the group attributed to each colony.
